newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - SITEL CUT TO OUTPERFORM.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - SITEL CUT TO OUTPERFORM.

text.p: Dillon Read said it downgraded SITEL Corp to outperform from buy.
-- cited SITEL's second quarter operating earnings of $0.10 a share compared with $0.06 a share a year ago.
-- cut the 1997 earnings estimate to $0.38 a share from $0.45 a share and cut the 1998 estimate to $0.58 a share from $0.63 a share.
-- SITEL's shares were indicated to open at a range of 10 to 11-1/2, down sharply from Wednesday's closing price of 15-1/4.
